edits.old: Then the grant refuses it and the boundary test fails the build
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses it and the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC11 Business rules with no criterion of their own (BR1 to BR5, BR7 to BR10)
    Given a claim on an instruction with a fee schedule version and a recorded result
    When the claim is recorded and then approved or refused
    Then the claim is a result on partner_instruction only, the decision record is written first, the claim is recorded once, the fee is checked against the schedule version and the recorded result, only status moves within LOV-INSTR-STATUS, the scope is the caller's firm, no personal data is written and one base, topic, queue, schema and login serve the service

  Scenario: AC12 Caller without credentials (401)
    Given a request to a provided operation with no valid credentials
    When the request is sent
    Then the answer is 401 and nothing is read or written

  Scenario: AC13 Write replayed with the same idempotency key (BR3)
    Given a write already recorded under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the answer is 409, and one claim and one EV-21 remain

  Scenario: AC14 Activity retried or timed out
    Given an activity of §12.5 is retried or times out
    When the retry or the timeout is handled
    Then no claim, status or invoice is written twice and the instruction keeps its status from before the attempt

  Scenario: AC15 Status change the model does not allow (BR5)
    Given an instruction whose status does not allow the approval or refusal
    When the approval or refusal is applied
    Then the answer is 409 and the status is not moved
